primitives.name: Asynchronous Feature Flagging
primitives.verbatim_quote: Feature-flag it `LEDGER_CHAIN_ENABLED` default OFF (founder flips; do not flip it yourself).

layer2.mapping: Enables gradual deployment and rollback of chain functionality through conditional execution paths.
layer2.telemetry: Flag toggle frequency, activation success rate, and system stability post-toggle.
